about: Outside research B (Brandon Oct 31 4:49 PM): POTA pin outside its official outline, US + Canada, 202 rows. Pin is: RIGHT PLACE = the outline we matched is the odd one (recheck the match), OFF = pin not at the park (label only, pins never move), UNIT = pin marks an entrance / separate unit, UNCLEAR. Review input; nothing live without chat 11.
